Rework #3 fix commit 6b80587 (tree e303d160) — exact refill budget (completed+active<=n_episodes, attempt_limit gates refill), slot lifecycle (INITIAL/ACTIVE/DONE/VOIDED, reset_at accepts only done/voided, abort_episode explicit discard, mark_voided, step_at), full-field source hash with resolved defaults matching TaskSpecRegistry, g3 hashes only the resolved pool + resolved_world_count=21, probe invariants exact (attempted==completed+voided, in_flight==0). GPU/PPO core untouched (裁决: not required). v3 remains as history (its evidence v4/_v2 superseded by rework #3; v2 attempted=123 in_flight=3 was the over-refill artifact rework #3 eliminates). changed_files = git diff c1f7dc1..HEAD = 57 + this manifest itself = 58 (P2-a: no self-exclusion). Rollback includes bf5f5c4/212cb3c/da17bfc + rework #3 carrying commit 6b80587, with the final closure backfill commit as placeholder.
